Original raw-cutoff validity, harmonic mass-one certificates, proved primorial coprimality, proved coefficient-unit arithmetic and the centered-source cube bound supply every hypothesis. The actual polynomial cube bound B is absorbed by mul_power, yielding a uniform rapidly small progression-removal error for every remaining direction tuple.

MaskTargetUnrestrictedTransfer defines the concrete unrestricted average with the same conditioned primes, original quotient direction pairs and anchor harmonic law. The actual progression and original target cube are transferred to this average with explicit summed caps and rapidly small difference. Every fixed V^q weighted difference tends to zero. This is a full source cube-law transfer, not a proof of decay of the unrestricted cube average itself.

MaskUnrestrictedAdditiveOutput composes the transfer with the already proved source_unshifted_additive_output. The actual unshifted correlation power is bounded by the same m-only coefficient times the absolute unrestricted one-variable cube average, plus a genuinely constructed error tending to zero. The unrestricted cube estimate remains explicit on the right-hand side, preserving the outstanding analytic task.
